ios.desc:
We have been working freelance for 5 years and have personally tried many applications for time tracking. The trackers that we used are either overflowing with functionality, or they do not have functions that are important to us. We decided that it would be much easier to create a tracker for ourselves and share it with the community of professionals such as Designers, Programmers, Data Analysts and other people who works as a Freelancer.

With our app, you can enjoy the following features:

- Add a new project;
- Create new tasks within projects and track time;
- Set an hourly rate for each project;
- Generate an invoice for the selected period;
- Analyze your daily work activity with statistics to evaluate your productivity;
- Control the timer with the Lock Screen Widget.

Our application requires less space than a photo on an iPhone.

We are open to suggestions and feedback! We will gladly respond to all your comments.
